#### Veeam

**Plug-Ins for Enterprise Applications**

This dashboard gives visibility into Plug-Ins for Enterprise Applications in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique tokens, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces recovery tokens, policies, and top source IPs. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a plug-in operations view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
